headline: Prudential Financial (PRU) Stock Still Looks Cheap With Strong Returns And Earnings Support
summary: Prudential Financial stock has delivered a 48.6% return over the past five years, and current checks suggest the market price still sits at a discount to its intrinsic value estimate based on the Excess Returns model and earnings multiples. A 48.6% five year return points to steady wealth creation, which makes any remaining valuation discount more important to understand.
